_comment: Phase 2a road-visual overhaul (worn-asphalt look, The Crew 2 art-direction target). CC0 PBR sets from ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com) - the whole site is published CC0 1.0 (public domain, no attribution required; see https://ambientcg.com/about). All zips fetched at 2K-JPG resolution via ambientCG's public download API (https://ambientcg.com/get?file=<AssetId>_2K-JPG.zip), no login required. Binaries are NOT committed to git (see download_road_textures.py + repo .gitignore) - re-run that script to repopulate this folder from the URLs below.

textures.notes: Primary worn asphalt - use for motorway/trunk/primary main travel lanes.
Secondary variant for material-instance blending/tiling breakup on longer stretches.
Third asphalt variant - residential/tertiary/service class roads (rougher, patchier look). No AO map shipped for this asset.
Shoulder/skirt material - the u0 UV goes outside [0,1] on skirt vertices, so the material can blend to this outside the pavement edge.
Optional - junction pads (experimental_junction_pads.py) if the follow-up agent wants a distinct road-rock/concrete surface there instead of asphalt. No AO map shipped for this asset.
